name: Arc
note: The help center answers automated requests with 403; the list was read from the Internet Archive snapshot of the same page (web.archive.org/web/2025/) on the check date.

quit.from: macOS convention; the cited page does not list it

goBack.from: Go back on tab history (Command-Left Arrow or Command-Left Bracket)

goForward.from: Go forward on tab history (Command-Right Arrow or Command-Right Bracket)

previousSpace.from: Switch between Spaces (Command-Option-Left Arrow or Option-Command-Right Arrow)

nextSpace.from: Switch between Spaces (Command-Option-Left Arrow or Option-Command-Right Arrow)

unbound.showSidebar: The page lists one Show/Hide the Sidebar command (Command-S), which Compact Mode takes; it lists no separate command to reveal a hidden sidebar over the page.
unbound.closeWindow: The page lists only Command-W, which closes the current tab or window.
unbound.focusTabList: The page lists no command to move the focus to the sidebar.
unbound.moveTabUp: The page lists no command to move a tab; Command-Option-Up Arrow switches tabs instead.
unbound.moveTabDown: The page lists no command to move a tab; Option-Command-Down Arrow switches tabs instead.
unbound.newSpace: The page lists no command to create a Space.
unbound.renameSpace: The page lists no command to rename a Space.
unbound.deleteSpace: The page lists no command to delete a Space.
unbound.moveSpaceLeft: The page lists no command to move a Space.
unbound.moveSpaceRight: The page lists no command to move a Space.
unbound.newFolder: The page lists no command to create a folder.
unbound.newProfile: The page lists no Profile command; Arc attaches a Profile to Spaces and switches it with them.
unbound.renameProfile: The page lists no Profile command; Arc attaches a Profile to Spaces and switches it with them.
unbound.deleteProfile: The page lists no Profile command; Arc attaches a Profile to Spaces and switches it with them.
unbound.previousProfile: The page lists no Profile command; Arc attaches a Profile to Spaces and switches it with them.
unbound.nextProfile: The page lists no Profile command; Arc attaches a Profile to Spaces and switches it with them.
